methodology: VPS SSH Brute-Force Defense (Belarus-bot class countermeasures)

steps.detail: bot class scans SSH and brute-forces DEFAULT combos only (root:root, admin:admin, support:support); 4,081 failed attempts surveyed on one fresh server in ~1 day
auto-bans brute-forcers; first bans happened within minutes of enabling
the entire bot's wordlist misses; password auth may be KEPT per operator ruling with a long unique password
ufw deny incoming + allow only served ports; no HTTP exposure for the scan side
keep VNC/console access (Contabo panel) for recovery; test key auth survives every sshd change before closing the session
